entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Yeah, yeah, get me a person. I need to return something and I'm not waiting.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and the email address on your VeloFit account?
Mark Peterson. The email is m.peterson@email.com. Just pull it up, you'll see I'm a VIP member. I buy a lot from you.

Okay, Mr. Peterson, I see your account here. Thank you for your loyalty with us. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker on your recent orders. To get started, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It's a preference! I completely changed my mind. Honestly, it was just an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I want to send it back for a full refund.
I understand. Let me just confirm the timeline. I see the band was delivered to you 29 days ago. Let me review the return eligibility for you.

29 days? Don't tell me that's a problem. I spend thousands of dollars here. If you give me any grief over this, I'll be speaking to your manager and posting reviews on every website I can find. This should be simple.

I completely understand your frustration, sir, and I assure you that won't be necessary. Please give me just one moment... Okay, I've just checked our policy. All of our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Oh. Well... good. That's the right answer. Finally, some simple service.

Of course. And listen, as a thank you for being such a valued VIP member, I'd also like to add a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. You won't have to worry about a private resale or anything like that; we're happy to take care of this for you.
A credit, huh? Fine. That's acceptable. Go ahead and start the return.

Excellent. I have just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it. Can I help with anything else today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mr. Peterson. Have a wonderful day.
